population.order_source: runner execution order (manifest walk), verified a permutation of the subset listing

boundary_and_payload_verification.note: the serialized body also carries the system message and a second schema copy in response_format; 'one image + one text block' describes the content array

fallback_policy.rule: use the primary whenever it returns a usable schema-valid transcription; use the secondary ONLY on a hard failure; never choose on quality, plausibility, hidden CER or downstream grader preference
fallback_policy.reference_blind: enforced structurally — select() takes only case_id, the two outcome dicts and the two texts, and a test proves that injecting reference/CER/split decoys changes no decision
fallback_policy.provenance: every fallback row is marked and flagged needs_review
fallback_policy.not_an_authorization: fallback use does not authorise production AUTO acceptance

interpretation_bands_pre_registered.scope: Gemini HARD provider failures among 32 crops
interpretation_bands_pre_registered.5+: unsuitable as the sole OCR route under this configuration
interpretation_bands_pre_registered.caveat: engineering interpretation bands, not population guarantees. A one-sided 95% upper bound will be reported alongside the point estimate, and no claim of a true failure rate below 5% will be made from n=32.

metric_views_pre_registered.A_successful_only_quality: CER/WER among usable outputs, coverage printed beside every metric
metric_views_pre_registered.B_failure_aware_quality: every intended crop; hard no-output penalised at CER 1.0 (documented maximum loss)
metric_views_pre_registered.D_prospective_fallback: primary where usable, secondary only on pre-registered triggers, full denominator

prohibitions: no manual retries beyond the runner's bounded policy
